supported.claim: The current project identity is Policy Lab, a case-based constraint research workbench. Historical SolarPunk / SPK / Sepolia material is reference-only.

The controlled interactive case pack includes five mechanism cases (TYN-001, AUS-001, PHX-001, OPS-001, CPT-001) that declare empirical_claim: false. CPT-001 is a Cape Town laboratory case with a controlled TMY-shaped resource context. PUB-AUSGRID-001P remains outside the interactive pack.

CPT-001 negative-control variants fail closed: retained-hash evidence tampering is rejected as an evidence hash mismatch; zero-surplus evidence is BLOCKED at POSITIVE_SURPLUS and does not silently admit.
PUB-AUSGRID-001P is a separate outside-public-data checkpoint at actual L0 assurance: 336 half-hour intervals, 33.066 kWh eligible surplus.

The same outside-data object yields different deterministic consequences under different declared policies: LAB-CASE-OPEN-004 -> ADMIT_WITH_LIMIT at 33.066 kWh; ENERGY-CASE-PILOT-005 -> BLOCKED by SIGNED_EVIDENCE and MIN_PROVENANCE.
A 40% declared settlement-capacity stress on the admitted open-policy quantity is PARTIAL: 13.2264 kWh covered / 19.8396 kWh shortfall. This is scenario accounting, not legal settlement.
Closed-world decision reproduction, capsule integrity, and schema validation are recorded as PASS for that checkpoint, with R1 NOT_ASSESSED, R2 PARTIAL, R3 PARTIAL, R4 UNTESTED.

supported.claim: A portable policylab.claim_assessment_package.v0.1 rendering can be built and independently verified from the closed case artifacts. Packaging does not create new evidence authority.

Scheduled Policy Lab Live Smoke on origin/main currently fails before the live page is tested, because the workflow asks setup-node to cache npm and then runs npm ci, while root package-lock.json is gitignored. The demo 200 is independent of that failure.
